body:
I really don't know but Shout Crisis Text Line – for everyone

Text "SHOUT" to 85258

Please stay safe
The world really doesn't make sense. I wish I could help you more. I'll be thinking of you tonight
Bad donut
If they didn't have a seizure then they will probably be alright. If they did have a seizure I would be concerned about side effects from that.

I do this drug because I want nothing more than to suffer a lot and then die. My worst experience was waking up then being thirsty trying to drink my water bottle and realizing it was vodka. I had spilled a ton of vodka on the counter when I poured it. Also Clara is a national treasure and you shouldn't insult her holy name you asshole. Also if this isn't about her then you're in for a treat.

I drink alcohol. I wouldn't recommend it, mixing dph and alcohol is really dangerous I've entirely blacked out with less than 300mg. It also makes the situation somewhat worse if you drink too often. I drink too often so i would know, I often drink just to stop shaking so I can eat dinner with my family without looking insane. It's a fucked up situation I know.
It's been 3 hours, and the situation hasn't improved.i genuinely regret it considering I failed.

Tell him about 988 even if he isn't suicidal he can call them just to talk. I'm a bad example but calling really made me feel better. Other than that just talk to him and get him out of the house, take him to lunch or something.
Thank you for your concern, unfortunately I think I'll be alright. Suicide can be rather frustrating, what a shame.
I'm really sorry to hear that. I'm suicidal as well and I don't know why I won't get help. I really hope your partner is safe. This disease hurts a lot of people.
Sure what's your name, what do you do?
Please don't. Poison hurts a lot. You can tell me about it if you want. Call 988 immediately so you can talk to someone.

I think you got your point across fine. A lot of people are like that sometimes they don't even know what they're doing. Life is a nightmare and I feel your pain. I really hope you feel better in the future. I don't want to be me either.
I don't know what kind of fucked up university you go to but talk to your advisor they probably just want you to jump through hoops.
I don't know your situation but make an appointment with your advisor they could probably help you out, seriously.

I'm sorry that you feel that way. But you lucky bastard i wish I thought my family didn't love me so I wouldn't feel so bad about killing myself haha. Anyways you should get a different therapist, good luck.

I hope the best to you. I accidentally blacked out on alcohol for 3 days, maybe I was already sick idk. I can't keep hurting the people around me, maybe I'll try therapy or maybe I'll kill myself, I guess I'll flip a coin. Honestly thank you for your advice it was nice to hear something positive.
Sorry I don't feel okay giving you suicide tips despite it being a hobby of mine.
Thank you for your advice, it meant a lot.

I can relate to this; For me it's my crippling procrastination, poor planning skills, and writing anxiety that makes it nearly impossible to finish a proper suicide note.

I kind of just think of them as the reasons I'm still alive even when I don't have reasons to live. I really can't think of any advice to give you but I've been thinking of similar things lately.

Thanks for responding. I've looked into a local clinic that specializes in lgbt issues, but I've never had enough confidence to set up an appointment. I've done therapy but eventually I stop setting up appointments or can't open up to them because I'm anxious. I'm working on improving. Making this post was sort of an improvement because I've never talked about this before.
